title: Assistant Vice President, Relationship Manager, Cross Industry, Corporate Banking
description:
**Business Function**  
  
Corporate and Investment Banking provides corporate customers with a full range of commercial banking products and services, including cash management services, current accounts, time deposits, trade finance, working capital finance, term loans and foreign exchange. Through our continued commitment, DBS has cultivated long-standing relationships with its customers in the region that are based on account relationship management, service differentiation, product development and rigorous credit standards.

**Job Purpose**

* To manage and sustain a portfolio of Corporate customers, building long term relationships founded on efficient and reliable support for their business. To work with product groups and other colleagues both in India and overseas to build our Local large corporate client base, and enhance wallet share from both new and existing customers.
* Risk assessment of facility clients in the form of continuous monitoring (writing memos, working through the approval process and working with RMG, Operations, product groups etc to ensure seamless delivery to the client).

**Key Accountabilities**

* Relationship Manager responsible for a portfolio of corporate clients. Manage relationships through constant interaction & account mapping at varied levels in client organizations, while ensuring a risk-adjusted portfolio contribution
* Determine the products that are most effective in meeting customer’s needs and be able to sell these both reactively and proactively. Customize, adapt & develop new products to increase profitability, reduce costs & ease operational bottlenecks.
* Implement & execute IBG1 business strategy to increase market share & to achieve targets consistent with IBG1’s revenue, ROE & Cost / Income ratio targets. Cross sell other products of the bank including cash, treasury, trade & others.
* Ensure the highest customer retention & increase in wallet share by constantly monitoring customer satisfaction levels through detailed MIS & tracking of operations & complaints. Ensure all regulatory reporting & compliances are enforced. Also ensure assistance to external & internal audits
* Develop the DBS brand in the region. Research different identified & appropriate market segments including analysis of key requirements for each segment. Build and develop a high performing team through embedding performance development and coaching. Create an empowering environment for the team, encouraging individual ownership and initiative. Ensure coaching and feedback in order to achieve their maximum potential. Make reward decisions within set guidelines.

**Job Duties & Responsibilities**

* Primary contact at CEO, Finance Director, and Treasurer level in Corporates controlling offices, discussing inter alia customer needs, service reviews, and credit risk issues.
* Advises and debates how business finances could be structured in the short-term and medium/long term.
* Grow the team’s portfolio profitability by identifying new and existing customer potential including sales opportunities and new product promotion initiatives.
* Control and quality of the portfolio, using available triggers and adherence to Risk management guidelines and policies.
* Formulate business development strategies and objectives to meet changing market needs.
* Develop prioritized target list & structured client calling plans in place and formulate client action plans.
* Monitor conformance of team using new relationship development procedures.
* Monitor results of customer surveys against target service quality standards.
* Monitor levels of complaints and quality of handling.
* Proactively researches competitive threats/opportunities within the team’s market and geographical area.
* Ensure that quality proposals are submitted to the credit chain

**Required Experience**

* Overall, 7-12 years of experience in corporate banking, MNC RM experience preferable.
* Proven track record in the corporate & commercial banking
* Sound understanding of products
* Sound Understanding of credit proposals
* Knowledge of competitors and market place

**Education / Preferred Qualifications**

* An MBA or CA with relevant number of years of experience in banking is preferable.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong selling and negotiation skills
* Excellent diagnostic skills and rigorous approach to problem solving
* Excellent communication skills at all levels
* Excellent comprehension skills to understand and interpret industry data and economic trends
* Sound financial counseling skills
* Strong credit risk analysis skills
* Strong formal presentation skills to gain acceptance to solutions, both internally and externally
* Team creation and co-ordination skills to mobilize and manage product specialists
* Proven leadership experience in leading & managing sales.
* Ability to think creatively and identify innovative solutions.

**Technical Competencies**

* Sound understanding corporate & commercial banking, products, credit proposals & approval processes, internal guidelines & policies.
* Understanding of regulatory guidelines on banking policies issued by RBI (local regulations in India) and local laws and regulations that impact businesses in general. Understanding of KYC requirements & Anti-money Laundering Policies are critical.
* Knowledge of financial markets and products to assist in meaningful dialogue with clients
* Financial Analysis and research capabilities. Evaluation of credit risks involved in credit proposals.

**Work Relationship**

* Working relationship with RM’s / Sales in CBG / CMS/ GTS to maximize opportunities and cross sell of products.
* Important and constant relationship with credit both in developing new products for IBG1 customers and maintaining the quality of the account’s portfolio.
* Close working relationship with internal support/ product functions such as Operations, Product Owners (eg T&M, Custody, GTS); Credit Risk & CCU for approval of credit lines, legal & compliance for regulatory & compliance issues etc.
* Working relationship with operations to ensure smooth delivery to the customer.

**DBS India - Culture & Behaviors**

* Drive Performance Through Value Based Propositions
* Ensure Customer Focus by Delighting Customers & Reduce Complaints
* Build Pride and Passion to Protect, Maintain and Enhance DBS’ Reputation
* Enhance Knowledge Base, Build Skill Sets & Develop Competencies
* Invest in Team Building & Motivation through Ideation & Innovation
* Execute at Speed While Maintaining Error Free Operations

**Job Type:** Full-time

**About Magnifico Resins**

Magnifico Resins is India’s fastest-growing brand in premium epoxy resins for art, décor, industrial, and commercial applications. We are now scaling our flooring vertical and looking for a result-driven sales leader to build and run the team that takes it to the next level.

**Role Overview**

As Team Lead – Flooring Sales, you will head our flooring sales team and own its revenue, targets, and growth. You will personally close key deals, coach your team to convert leads into orders, and handle important client interactions, both from the office and at project sites. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who sells, closes, and leads from the front.

Key Responsibilities

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and motivate the flooring sales team to achieve monthly and quarterly targets
* Set daily and weekly activity goals, review pipelines, and run regular sales meetings
* Train the team on product knowledge, pitching, objection handling, and closing techniques
* Track individual and team performance and take corrective action when needed

**Sales & Closing**

* Personally handle high-value deals, negotiations, and closures

**Site Visits & Client Management**

* Visit project sites when required for requirement assessment, technical discussions, and closing

* Build strong relationships with contractors, applicators, consultants, and key accounts

**Reporting & Coordination**

* Maintain accurate pipeline, follow-up, and sales records in the CRM
* Coordinate with operations, logistics, and marketing for smooth order fulfilment and post-sale support
* Share weekly and monthly sales reports, forecasts, and market insights with management

**Who You Are**

* Proven track record in B2B or project sales with strong closing ability
* Experience leading or mentoring a sales team, or ready to step up into a team lead role
* Comfortable working both in the office and on site, travelling locally as needed
* **Preferred:** background in construction chemicals, flooring, waterproofing, coatings, paints, or building materials
* Good understanding of epoxy or industrial flooring systems is a big advantage
* Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills
* Excellent communication in English, Hindi, and Gujarati
* Working knowledge of CRM tools and Excel/Google Sheets
* Target-driven, accountable, and a natural leader

**Key skills:** team handling, B2B sales, project sales, closing, negotiation, key account management, channel and contractor sales, construction chemicals, epoxy flooring, industrial flooring, technical selling, sales forecasting, CRM

Why Join Magnifico?

* Lead a team in a high-growth, fast-moving brand
* Real ownership of a business vertical, with direct access to management
* Exposure to B2B, project, and channel sales across industries
* Supportive, young, and ambitious team culture

**Also searched as:** Sales Team Leader, Team Lead Sales, Sales Manager, Area Sales Manager, Business Development Manager, Senior Sales Executive, Project Sales Manager, B2B Sales Manager, Key Account Manager, Construction Chemicals Sales, Flooring Sales Manager, Technical Sales Manager, Channel Sales Manager, Sales Head (Flooring)

title: Product Manager
description:
**Job Title: Product Manager**  
**Location: Ahmedabad**  
**Experience : 2-4 years**  
**Company : JigNect Technologies**

**About Us:**

JigNect is a global, AI-first Quality Engineering partner that helps companies ship faster, safer, and smarter software. We turn QA from a late-stage testing phase into a predictive, scalable quality system that runs across the entire software lifecycle. Our expertise covers automation, performance, security, accessibility, and QE consulting for clients in industries such as Healthcare, BFSI, SaaS, Retail, and more. Beyond services, JigNect builds its own AI products: AIDrivenTesting.ai, a suite of AI-powered testing extensions and studios covering every stage of the STLC, and Orkestraa.ai, an enterprise platform for governed AI agents, shared knowledge, and token management. At JigNect, you'll work where AI meets quality engineering, on real client challenges and on products built for the AI-native era.

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a proactive Product Manager to take end-to-end ownership of our product, from ideation and strategy to development, launch, and continuous improvement. You will define the product roadmap, prioritize features, and translate business goals into actionable requirements. Working closely with development, QA, design, and leadership teams, you will ensure timely delivery and product quality. The ideal candidate should have a strong sense of ownership, strategic thinking, and the ability to drive product success.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **End-to-End Product Ownership:** Take complete responsibility for the product lifecycle, from ideation and planning to development, launch, and continuous improvement.
* **Product Strategy & Roadmap:** Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and priorities in alignment with business goals.
* **Requirement Gathering:** Understand business needs, user pain points, and market opportunities to define product requirements and features.
* **Backlog Management:** Create and maintain product backlogs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature priorities.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with development, QA, design, and leadership teams to ensure smooth execution and timely delivery.
* **Execution & Delivery:** Monitor development progress, resolve blockers, manage dependencies, and ensure milestones are achieved.
* **Quality & User Experience:** Collaborate with QA and design teams to ensure product functionality, usability, reliability, and overall user experience.
* **Market & Competitor Research:** Study market trends, competitor products, and customer feedback to identify opportunities for product improvement.
* **Product Launch & Adoption:** Plan product releases, coordinate launch activities, and support user onboarding and adoption.
* **Performance Monitoring:** Define product KPIs, track performance, analyze user feedback, and drive improvements based on data.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Keep leadership and relevant stakeholders informed about product progress, risks, priorities, and outcomes.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 2–4 years of experience in product management, product ownership, or a similar role.
* Experience managing a software product through multiple stages of its lifecycle.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and software development processes.
* Ability to convert business requirements into clear product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience with product management and project tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and drive teams toward shared goals.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience building a product from scratch or working on an early-stage product.
* Understanding of SaaS products, software testing, Quality Engineering (QE), or AI-driven solutions.
* Familiarity with product analytics, user research, wireframes, and prototyping tools.
* Experience working with engineering teams on API integrations, automation, or AI-powered features.
* A strong sense of product ownership with a focus on business outcomes and customer value.

**Benefits:**

* Health Care Benefits
* Flexibility @Work
* Fun Loving Culture
* Trips, Events & Celebrations
* Career Growth

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
